descriptionByLocale.it:
• Dalla visita alla visita: clienti, parenti e me.
• "Il buon lavoro ha bisogno di un buon ambiente"
• Creiamo un campo di lavoro in cui i nostri dipendenti sono motivati, autodeterminati e in gran parte auto-organizzati per costruire relazioni.
• Non vediamo l'ora di condividere la nostra conoscenza e l'umorismo con voi presto.
• Cerchiamo immediatamente o con accordo.
• Sono interessati e motivati ad essere sulla strada indipendentemente, ma ad agire come parte del team di trattamento
• per accompagnare e sostenere i clienti anche in situazioni difficili
• per scambiare come assistenti con partner esterni, come i medici di famiglia, il team PallCare, la consulenza nutrizionale, il personale in ospedali e case
• per lavorare alla soluzione-oriented, in base al processo di cura elettronica
• strumenti tecnici moderni (Natel, tablet, Beekeeper come piattaforma di comunicazione interna)
• documentazione elettronica del cliente (Perigon) su Natel o tablet
• scambio professionale e personale mirato (caso discussione, eventi di squadra, ecc)
• una cultura di errore in cui i problemi sono affrontati apertamente e discussi
• una cultura di apprendimento vissuta e uno scambio di conoscenze mirato
• una vasta gamma di servizi, con cui le esigenze dei nostri clienti Se avete domande, il team di Wetzikon è direttamente a vostra disposizione: Tel. 044 576 00 dossier applicabile a bewerbungen@spitex-bachtel.ch o Spitex Bachtel, Personal, Binzstrasse 31, 8620 Wetzikon, Tel. 044 576 00 14. • From visit to visit: customers, relatives and me.

• We create a field of work in which our employees are motivated, self-determined and largely self-organized to build relationships.
• We look forward to sharing our knowledge and humor with you soon.
• We search immediately or by agreement.
• Nursing specialist HF for the Wetzikon base

• to be on the road independently, but to act as part of the treatment team
• to accompany and support customers even in difficult situations
• to exchange as caregivers with external partners, such as family doctors, the PallCare team, the nutrition consultancy, the staff in hospitals and homes
• to work solution-oriented, based on the care process,
• to record the care documentation electronically with the customers
• to work in the interdisciplinary team with a wide variety of professional groups and to exchange ideas
• to engage in case discussions and to exchange work together
• to move in different roles in everyday work - to be understood as a role model, as caregivers, as day-to-day managers, as specialists of Spitex, among others
• to work according to plan and at the same time to take on responsibility for his work - to develop professionally and to share their knowledge with the team, as well as to support others
• to be attentive to themselves and to reflect with regard to demarcation
• to be mobile with their own or with the business vehicle
• As a company, we support our employees in the care and support through ...

• electronic customer documentation (Perigon) on the Natel or tablet
• targeted professional and personal exchange (case discussion, team events, etc.)
• a culture of error in which problems are openly addressed and discussed
• a lived learning culture and targeted knowledge exchange

• customers and their relatives are covered
